files.description: Company revenue per calendar quarter (30 rows, oldest first, one row per quarter with no gaps): quarter_start (first day of the quarter as text, YYYY-MM-DD, from 2019-01-01 to 2026-04-01), revenue (whole number), new_accounts (whole number).

task_text: The quarter_start dates should form a regular calendar series. Let pandas work out the spacing of these dates and report it as a frequency alias. `result` should be that alias (a short text code).
intended_computation: The dates are consecutive quarter starts (1 January, 1 April, 1 July, 1 October), so the answer is the alias for quarterly spacing anchored on quarter starts.

acceptable_variants.notes: any alias that means quarter-start spacing on calendar quarters is acceptable: 'QS', 'QS-JAN', 'QS-APR', 'QS-JUL' or 'QS-OCT'.

predicted_direction.reason: 3.1 reports the anchor month January instead of October; both aliases describe the same calendar-quarter starts

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 in package TASKS_M1; task text, card, naive solution, reference and predicted direction were prepared there.
